question: What additional ritual elements are included in chapter eleven?
premises: The superiority over other scriptural groups is stated.
Worship of the wheel on all sides is performed.
Taking possession of the site, the five cow products, and worship of earth and Gaṇeśa are included.
inference: Chapter 11 combines doctrinal assertion with site consecration and protective worship.
uncertainties: kṣetragrahaḥ may refer to ritually securing the sacred ground.
plain_english: The superiority over other scriptural groups, worship of the wheel on all sides, taking possession of the site, the five cow products, and worship of the earth and Gaṇeśa are included.
